lines.text: That last-minute goal was so clutch.

data.define: Used when someone does well at an important time.

example.text: That last-minute goal was so clutch.

misuse.text: Don't say 'clutch' about a small purse.
misuse.why: Here it means great under pressure.

data.l1_hook: Gol de último segundo garante a vitória! "clutch"
data.l1_ex: Aquele gol de última hora foi muito "clutch".

native.tip: “clutch” = decisivo. Exemplo: “That last-minute goal was so clutch.”
native.caption:
O que significa “clutch”?
“clutch” = decisivo.
Exemplo: “That last-minute goal was so clutch.” (Aquele gol de última hora foi muito "clutch".)
